findings.title: The public findMany API was removed without a replacement query API
findings.body: This change deletes `InsightsBookingService.findMany`, which previously executed the authorized `bookingTimeStatusDenormalized.findMany` query and accepted normal Prisma findMany arguments. The only replacement is `getBaseConditions()`, which returns a SQL fragment and requires every caller to reimplement query execution, selection, pagination, ordering, and safe composition. Existing consumers invoking `service.findMany(...)` will fail to compile (or fail at runtime for untyped consumers), and no caller migrations are included in this PR. Preserve a compatible execution method or update all consumers as part of the same change.
